name: Halong
title: Typhoon Halong, October 2025
impact: +45 kt in 24 hours over unusually warm water, then a sharp turn east past Japan at 25 kt.
events:
The IBTrACS track begins far south
of Japan on 3 Oct.

Rapid intensification: +45 kt over
the next 24 hours (IBTrACS). The sea
is 1-2 °C warmer than normal (JMA).

JTWC expects a turn north-east around
the subtropical ridge, with high
confidence in the track.

Centre passes near Aogashima.
Hachijo-jima: 54.7 m/s gust,
record rainfall.

Turns east and speeds up to more
than 25 kt.

Its remains later bring record water
levels to western Alaska.
